name: Piešťany (Slovakia)
description: Six equal horizontal stripes of yellow, blue, white, blue, yellow and white, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature P-3/1991.
